description: Land Acquisition - Compensation for the Acquisition of the Land in Wattala D/S Division, Gampaha District
categorisation: This gazette notice is exclusively about land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It details the deposit of statutory compensation for a specific parcel of land (including its name, lot number, extent, and location) that was acquired by the state. The content is focused solely on land and property-related administrative procedures, fitting the definition of a Land Gazette.
